CFB-week.summary: Texas A&M is thin at receiver (Terry Bussey out for the season, Mario Craver and Kelshaun Johnson sat out last week), pushing targets to sophomore TK Norman as a 13.5-point road underdog at Alabama. Oregon's quarterback job is unsettled with Dante Moore out since a Sept. 27 concussion and Dylan Raiola/Brock Thomas splitting time, while Illinois starts freshman Michael Clayton II for the injured Katin Houser. Iowa turns to Jeremy Hecklinski at QB at Minnesota; Tennessee's DeSean Bishop has carried 32-34 times in two of three games since George MacIntyre took over at QB, but no named-book line…

NBA-BKN-at-CLE-1024.summary: Early-season game with little fresh reporting. Jarrett Allen (right patellar tendinopathy) was a game-time decision for the opener but is not on the current report; Brooklyn is without Tyler Bilodeau.

NBA-HOU-at-ATL-1025.summary: Atlanta opened with a 132-125 win at Orlando and is without backup bigs Mouhamed Gueye (foot) and Henri Veesaar (knee), which leaves more center minutes for Onyeka Okongwu. Houston beat San Antonio 114-110 Friday, with Sengun (29-7) and Amen Thompson (20-10) carrying the load.

NBA-MIL-at-PHI-1024.summary: Embiid is confirmed to play Saturday and sit Sunday's back-to-back leg vs Detroit; LeBron is questionable with back/sciatica management and the team says it will manage his load. Milwaukee (post-Giannis trade, new coach) is on the second night of a back-to-back after losing 132-125 to Chicago Friday.

NBA-SA-at-DAL-1025.summary: Both teams are on the second night of a back-to-back. Dallas is without Cooper Flagg (left shoulder, hurt Friday at Indiana), Lively, Aldama and Biberovic, but Kyrie Irving is active and starting (not in the app's starter list), so the ball runs through him. Spurs lose Tobias Harris (calf).

NFL-CIN-at-BAL-1025.summary: Lamar Jackson (high ankle sprain) was limited all week and is a game-time decision after missing two games; Baltimore scored 10 points with Tyler Huntley last week. The market has swung hard toward Cincinnati (BAL -3/-3.5 open to roughly pick'em) and the total fell from 50.5-51.5 to 47.5-48.5. Baltimore's secondary is thin (S Hawkins out, CB Tampa doubtful) while the Bengals are fully healthy out of their bye.

NFL-CLE-at-TEN-1025.summary: Low-total game (36.5). Cam Ward has been inefficient, especially against man coverage, and Cleveland plays the most man coverage in the league with a stingy pass defense over the past five weeks. Calvin Ridley (hip) missed Thursday's practice.

NFL-DAL-at-PHI-1027.summary: Light pass (Monday night). Philadelphia is on Tanner McKee with Hurts on IR, and DeVonta Smith, Goedert and Wicks did not practice Thursday or Friday; on defense, edge rushers Nolan Smith and Jonathan Greenard and nickel CB Michael Carter look unlikely. Pickens practiced fully Friday and says his shoulder is fine.

NFL-DEN-at-ARI-1025.summary: With Jeremiyah Love out again, Bam Knight (15-80) clearly outran Tyler Allgeier (18-38) last week, which explains Allgeier's rushing line crashing from 46.5 to 29.5. Denver gets CB Pat Surtain back at practice (questionable), and rookie RB Jonah Coleman, designated to return from IR and practicing fully, could cut into J.K. Dobbins' carries.

NFL-GB-at-DET-1025.summary: Detroit comes off a bye with center Cade Mays back, while Green Bay's defense is missing Micah Parsons, Javon Hargrave and both starting linebackers (Edgerrin Cooper on IR, Zaire Franklin out), so backups McDuffie and Hopper start. Josh Jacobs looks set to debut after coming off the exempt list, which should shrink MarShawn Lloyd's role.

NFL-IND-at-MIN-1025.summary: Unbeaten Minnesota hosts a 2-4 Colts team missing TE Tyler Warren, WR Anthony Gould and CB Sauce Gardner. Daniel Jones has more interceptions than touchdowns and was sacked six times last week, now facing Flores' blitz-heavy defense, which allows touchdowns on only a quarter of red-zone trips. Jefferson, Hockenson and Addison all practiced fully Friday.

NFL-KC-at-SEA-1026.summary: Kansas City plays without Rashee Rice again (hamstring) and with WR Tyquan Thornton on IR, against a Seattle defense that leads the league in yards per play allowed. KC has passed 33 or fewer times in four straight games, while Brashard Smith's absence leaves the backfield to Kenneth Walker III in his return to Seattle.

NFL-LA-at-LV-1025.summary: The 2-4 Rams are without Davante Adams (hamstring, 6-10 weeks) and Puka Nacua is a true question mark after leaving Thursday's practice and sitting out Friday (calf); McVay will decide Sunday. Their defensive interior is missing Poona Ford and Kobie Turner, while Raiders RB2 Mike Washington missed the last two practices.

NFL-MIA-at-NYJ-1025.summary: A low-total game (39.5): winless Miami has scored an NFL-low 70 points with the second-worst passing offense, and the Jets allow the fourth-fewest passing yards. Breece Hall is questionable after limited practices Thursday and Friday; WR Caleb Douglas returns for Miami.

NFL-NYG-at-HOU-1025.summary: J.J. McCarthy makes his first Giants start (acquired from Minnesota) after relieving Jameis Winston in Week 6 and leading three scoring drives. Houston is without both safeties Jalen Pitre and Reed Blankenship plus RB David Montgomery; the spread moved from 9.5 to about 10 on the QB news.

NFL-PIT-at-NO-1025.summary: Neutral-site game in Paris (Saints the home side). Pittsburgh is short at receiver (Pittman and Roman Wilson on IR, Skowronek out), making rookie Germie Bernard the clear WR2; the app's starter list wrongly shows Wilson. Previews expect Pittsburgh to lean on Jaylen Warren against a Saints run defense ranked last in rush EPA, while Shough is playing through two reported broken bones in his non-throwing hand.

NFL-SF-at-ATL-1025.summary: San Francisco's receiver room is gutted: Evans and Deebo Samuel are out (plus Demarcus Robinson, Stribling, Pearsall) and Christian Kirk makes his debut after a camp-long calf injury, so Purdy's volume should funnel to Kittle and McCaffrey. Atlanta loses RB Brian Robinson, leaving Bijan with the backfield.

NFL-TB-at-CAR-1025.summary: Baker Mayfield returns from a dislocated throwing thumb (wearing a protective glove) after three games out, but Tampa is without Egbuka, RT Goedeke and S Winfield. Carolina's Chuba Hubbard has become a true bellcow (19+ carries three straight games, 28 last week) while Bryce Young is throwing for 281+ every start with Coker back.

fix.summary: Quality-gate pass: quick availability, role and line checks on picks that rose into the Top 10s after research. Main finds: Cal's Emory is now the lead back, Texas Tech's Dickey is out again, Manning starts under pressure, and LeBron is questionable.

NBA-HOU-at-SA-1024.summary: San Antonio opened with a coach-confirmed three-guard lineup (Fox, Castle, Harper) plus Vassell and Wembanyama while Tobias Harris (calf) sat, and lost 116-104 to OKC. Fox and Harper shared playmaking (7 and 5 assists), leaving Castle as a scorer (24 pts, 1 ast) and Vassell squeezed (7 pts, 3 reb). Harris's return date is open, which could shift roles again.

best.why: Hubbard has become Carolina's workhorse, with 28 carries last week and 20 the start before, while Jonathon Brooks is on IR and Trevor Etienne barely plays. He carries no injury tag on the final report, and the 17.5 line still reflects older split-backfield games.
